hero.heading: I take projects and products from first idea to delivery.
hero.description: 14 years leading projects for Dell, Microsoft, Intel and Google, mostly in agencies where deadlines move fast. Now co-founder of Hay.chat, an AI support platform I took from first backlog to live product.

about.main: I started out in media production, so structure and story come naturally to me. I don't swear by any one methodology. What matters is getting things done, and making the process easier for everyone along the way.
about.secondary: I've launched a podcast series that passed 100,000 downloads, built internal playbooks people actually use, and run campaigns across formats, teams and time zones. But the size of the brand was never the point.
